**[1]** Nottingham, M.; Wilde, E.; Dalal, S. "Problem Details for HTTP APIs."

instance), extension member naming conventions, about:blank default, JSON Schema
(Appendix A), security considerations, IANA registry establishment.

Registration policy: Specification Required. Experts: Mark Nottingham, Sanjay Dalal.
